messages:
incident-bot: PAGING eng-sre oncall (mira) — Dedicated pool 'lacuna-prod' GPU exhaustion for tenant 'NovusLabs'. Queue +620, 12/12 GPUs 96-100% util, pod restarts observed. Severity: P1. https://grafana.redwood/lacuna

mira: oncall here, joining.

sam: grabbing graphs now — GPU util all at 96-100%, inflight queue +600, avg token latency spiking 2.1s -> 5.8s, TCP retry rate up.

derek: quick config check: lacuna-prod is pinned to 12 GPUs (tenant pin). auto-burst = false by policy.

ops-bot: AUTO-BURST BLOCKED — tenant pin policy 'dedicated_12' prevents automatic allocation. Manual action required.

mira: options: 1) manual burst from spare pool, 2) enable preemptible nodes, 3) force model fallback to smaller variant, 4) contact customer for traffic shaping. Need quick decision.

janet-cs: pinged Novus account team, letting them know we're investigating. Preparing a short message to avoid surprise.

derek: infra check — we have 4 preemptible GPUs in us-west-spare and 2 on hotstandby in the regional surge pool. Manual burst +4 preemptible would cut queue but not restore steady-state. Risk: preemptible eviction; must set rollback.

mira: decision: enable manual burst +4 preemptible for 45m with automatic rollback and notify customer. If queue doesn't drop in 10m, we'll trigger model-fallback for write-heavy routes.

sam: executing: 
```
redwoodctl pool burst --pool lacuna-prod --add 4 --type preemptible --duration 45m --authorizer sam
```

ops-bot: AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED: infra-lead approval.

derek: approved. proceeding. :thumbsup:

sam: burst request accepted — scheduling 4 preemptible nodes. pods pending scheduling.

mira: monitoring — queue down 420 in 3m, tail latency trending toward 2.3s. Good initial effect.

janet-cs: message sent to Novus: "We're applying emergency capacity to your dedicated pool for ~45m to restore latency. We'll follow up with root cause and any credits. Please escalate if you see errors."

mira: creating incident ticket INC-1799552468, tagging eng-runtime, eng-infra, and cs. Owners: sam (mitigation), derek (infra), janet-cs (customer comms).

sam: follow-up tasks: collect kernel GPU metrics, check recent scheduling events, snapshot model load and prompt-profile.

derek: prioritizing a post-incident runbook update: allow opt-in emergency burst for pinned tenants with supervised preemptible nodes.

mira: handing off to eng-oncall for 30m watch in #incidents-watch. I'll remain available for re-escalation.

janet-cs: Novus replies: "Thanks — we see improvement. Please keep us posted."

mira: marking mitigation successful for now. Will keep thread updated with ticket and timeline. Postmortem owners to meet tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar: 

ops-bot: NOTE — burst will auto-rollback at 2026-03-17T00:45:00Z unless extended.

mira: closing main thread, continuing watch in #incidents-watch."
